---
title: "Load counts from big CSV files"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r,message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```


Sometime gene expression matrices are given into big CSV or tab-delimited files.
This notebook show how to convert them into H5 format.


# Demo with GEO dataset GSE190012
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE213828 

```{r}
count_m <- read.delim("apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE213828/GSE213828_merged_counts.txt.gz")
metaD <- read.delim("apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE213828/GSE213828_merged_sample_info.txt.gz",row.names = "qp_well_fq")

o <- SingleCellExperiment(list(counts=data.matrix(count_m[,-1:-2])),
                     rowData=count_m[,1:2],
                     colData=metaD,mainExpName = "Gene Expression")
rownames(o) <- make.unique(mcols(o)$gene_name)
```

The SingleCellEperiment object is ready to use.


#Save object

```{r eval=FALSE}
ABAData::writeSingleCellExperiment(o, "datasets/GSE213828")
```
